detaileddescription.para: This function is the interrupt handler for the CLK_WIZ core.

This handler reads the pending interrupt from the Interrupt Status register determines the source of the interrupts and calls the respective callbacks for the interrupts that are enabled in Interrupt Enable register and finally clears the interrupts.

The application is responsible for connecting this function to the interrupt system. Application beyond this core is also responsible for providing callbacks to handle interrupts and installing the callbacks using XClk_Wiz_SetCallBack() during initialization phase.

detaileddescription.para: This file contains a design example using the XClk_Wiz driver with interrupts. It generates interrupts for a clock glitch, clock overflow, and underflow. Set up two clocking wizard instances. One instance acts as the clock monitor (enable the clock monitor in the GUI). On the other instance, enable dynamic clock reconfiguration. This example assigns XCLK_WIZ_DYN_DEVICE_ID to clock wizard 1. Modify this value for the dynamic-reconfiguration clocking wizard.

This example requires an interrupt controller connected to the processor and the MIPI CLK_WIZ in the system.
